ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  360 ONE WAM Limited has declared a second interim dividend for FY2026-27, which will be subject to mandatory tax withholding under the new Income-tax Act, 2025. Shareholders are required to update bank details, ensure PAN-Aadhaar linkage, and submit all necessary tax exemption documents through a dedicated online portal by October 23, 2026. A significant red flag is the company's firm stance that failure to provide complete and timely documentation will result in higher tax deductions, with no liability for the company to refund over-deducted amounts, placing the onus for claims directly on the shareholders with tax authorities.
